in_vivo_species.section: METHODS - Acute effects in CRE-Luc mice

in_vivo_species.section: METHODS - Subchronic administration in diet-induced obesity (DIO) mice

ex_vivo_detail: Mature white adipocytes freshly isolated from mouse epididymal fat by collagenase digestion and then acutely stimulated (60 min) with native secretin, BI-3434 or isoproterenol; lipolysis read out as glycerol release. The article itself calls this assay 'in vitro'; it is recorded here as ex vivo because it is tissue taken out of a body and then treated. Luciferase induction in organs of dosed CRE-Luc mice is also described as 'Ex vivo analysis', but that is terminal tissue analysis of an in vivo experiment.
in_vitro_detail: cAMP Hunter CHO-K1 SCTR Gs cell line (stably expressing human SCTR) used for concentration-response cAMP assays; human preadipocytes cultured and differentiated to adipocytes for SCTR expression analysis; RT-qPCR of SCTR in human cells and human fat tissue RNA.

agents.name: BI-3434 (lipidated long-acting secretin analog)
agents.sequence: not reported (body describes a Ser->Aib substitution at position 2, a C-terminal GK-motif and a fatty-acid half-life-extension group on the Lys33 side chain; the one-letter sequence is shown only in the Figure 1 structure image)
agents.sequence_source: RESULTS - 'A long-acting SCTR agonist was designed by protecting the proteolytically sensitive N-terminal region using a Ser to 2-aminoisobutyric acid (Aib) substitution in position 2'
agents.group_n: n = 3/group (PK); n = 8-10/group (acute food intake); n = 6/group (CRE-Luc); n = 8/group (DIO 8-day); n = 8-10/group (28-day combination)
agents.group_n_quote: administered with a single i.v. or s.c. dose of 30 nmol/kg BI-3434 or stapled secretin (n = 3/group)
agents.dose: 30 nmol/kg single dose (PK); 30, 100 and 300 nmol/kg (acute food intake); 3, 10, 30, 100 and 300 nmol/kg (CRE-Luc); 300 nmol/kg twice daily for 8 or 28 days (DIO)
agents.dose_route_quote: we then investigated the half-life of lipidated BI-3434 after administering 30 nmol/kg i.v. or s.c. to NMRI mice
agents.half_life: not reported as t1/2; Results report a mean residence time (MRT) of 6 h and the Discussion states half-life increased 'by more than 100x up to 6 h in mice'
agents.cmax: 70.9 nM (after 30 nmol/kg i.v. or s.c.); plasma exposure in DIO mice 2 h post-dose was 893 nM on day 1 and 914 nM at end of study at 300 nmol/kg
agents.pk_quote: this peptide showed a prolonged exposure with a MRT (mean residence time) of 6 h, a Cmax of 70.9 nM and a tmax of 2 h
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - BI-3434 is a long-acting SCTR agonist in vivo

agents.name: Stapled secretin (lactam-bridged secretin analog)
agents.sequence: not reported (only described as 'the secretin analog with lactam bridge'; no one-letter sequence printed in the body)
agents.group_n_quote: administered with a single i.v. or s.c. dose of 30 nmol/kg BI-3434 or stapled secretin (n = 3/group)
agents.dose: 30 nmol/kg single dose (PK); 30, 100 and 300 nmol/kg (acute food intake)
agents.dose_route_quote: Stapled secretin or BI-3434 (both 30, 100 and 300 nmol/kg, s.c.) were applied 1 h before the dark cycle.
agents.pk_quote: We first investigated the PK properties after i.v. injection of the secretin analog with lactam bridge (stapled secretin). This peptide displayed a short half-life of <15 min
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - BI-3434 is a long-acting SCTR agonist in vivo

agents.name: Native human secretin

agents.name: Semaglutide (GLP-1R agonist)

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. S2A (stapled secretin) and Fig. S2B (BI-3434); supplementary figures, captions not reproduced in the body text
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: This peptide displayed a short half-life of <15 min (Fig. S2A). ... this peptide showed a prolonged exposure with a MRT (mean residence time) of 6 h, a Cmax of 70.9 nM and a tmax of 2 h (Fig. S2B).
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration-time profiles after single 30 nmol/kg i.v. or s.c. dose in NMRI mice; the figures are supplementary and their captions are not included in the supplied body text. Exposure figures S2C and S3R are also referenced.

bioanalytical_method: LC-MS/MS (solid phase extraction on OASIS MAX or WCX uElution plate, Aeris WIDEPORE column, ABSciex 6500+ Triple Quad in positive ionization mode)
bioanalytical_quote: Quantification of peptides in plasma was performed using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry.
notes: No numeric elimination half-life (t1/2) is reported for BI-3434 in the body; the Results give MRT, Cmax and tmax and the Discussion refers loosely to a half-life 'up to 6 h'. Stapled secretin has only an upper-bound half-life (<15 min) after i.v. dosing and no other PK parameters. Peptide sequences appear only in the Figure 1 structure image, which is not transcribed in the text, so all sequences are recorded as not reported. The freshly isolated mouse adipocyte lipolysis assay is called 'in vitro' by the authors but was classified ex vivo per protocol; the cell-line cAMP assay is the unambiguous in vitro component. Several body paragraphs in the source file were truncated at 2000 characters.
